contents.content:
Whitefield is an happening suburb in Bangalore that has emerged to be a superior locality due to the unique combination of commercial hubs, residential spaces, lifestyle amenities, and good connectivity. It is emerged to be one of the most sought-after neighborhoods among professionals, families, and visitors. This blog covers all the important points on why Whitefield Stands Out as a Premier Locality in Bangalore.


Tech Parks


The major attractions that have come up in Whitefield are the successful IT parks that have emerged to be one of the biggest employment hubs now. It attracts professionals from all around the world and is thereby boosting the economy of the place.


Some of the Key Tech Parks in Whitefield:

International Tech Park Bangalore (ITPB): 

International tech park bangalore (IPTB) shortly known as ITPB is a Bangalore tech park located in Whitefield, 18 km from the heart of the city. This park offers campus facilities to multinational giants like Huawei, Oracle, Perot Systems, Applied Materials, GalaxE Solutions, IPsoft, General Motors and many more.

Location: ITPL Main Rd, Pattandur Agrahara, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066

Brigade Software Park: 

Brigade Software Park is a landmark project of Brigade Group located in a SEZ near the IT hub of Whitefield. It offers superior connectivity to the Outer Ring Road. Companies present in Brigade Tech gardens include incadea India Pvt. Ltd, INSZoom,Standard Chartered GBS(Scope International), Creative Synergies Consulting and more.

Location: 1, Brigade Tech Gardens, Kundalahalli, Brookefields Green Avenue, Kundalahalli, ITPL Main Rd, Phase 2, Brookefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560037

Kalyani Tech Park: 

Kalyani Tech Park in Whitefield is a highly planned project offering a contemporary lifestyle. Located in one of the most sought-after pin codes (560037) in Bangalore. Companies present in Kalyani Tech park include Cognizant, Accenture, Wipro.

Location: Opposite Brookfield Hospital, EPIP Zone, Brookefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560037

Healthcare Facilities

Whitefield has the best healthcare facilities in Bangalore. It offers the highest standard of medical care under all specialties. Hospitals in Whitefield are equipped with the latest technology and some of the most qualified doctors and medical professionals serve patients' routine and complicated healthcare needs. Healthcare institutions here deliver services that are efficient and reliable, so patients prefer to come here for treatment. Families and professionals who stay nearby avail the services offered there.

Top Hospitals:

Manipal Hospitals:

Manipal hospital is a multi-specialty hospital in Whitefield, leading with the world-class health care service along with the top-most doctors. They provide the fullest range of treatments and surgical procedures under the departments.

Location: ITPL Main Rd, opposite Prestige Shantiniketan, KIADB Export Promotion Industrial Area, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066

Cloudnine Hospitals:

Cloudnine hospital specializes in women and children's health as a way to bridge the difference between Indian and international requirements of care. They are professionally skilled and motivated to provide the best services. 

Location: Survey No. 88, Nagarjuna Sai Signet, 2nd Floor, Plot No. 11, Whitefield Main Rd, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066

Svastha Hospitals:

Svastha Hospital offers qualitative and holistic services in a friendly ambience to the patients. They are known for their emphasis on clinical excellence, safety, dignity, and transparency at affordable costs.

Location: Site No. 3, Main Road, Narayanappa Garden, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066

Aster Hospitals:

Aster hospital is under  the banner of the chain of DM Healthcare; provides a world class patient-centric environment along with high-tech medical apparatus and emphasis on delivering only the best clinical results.

Location: Plot No. 3 & 4, Sadaramangala Industrial Area, off Whitefield Main Road, opposite ITPL, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066

These hospitals create a healthier ecosystem by providing residents quality medical care.

Educational Institutions (Schools)

Whitefield is known for their quality education. Schools are committed to academic excellence and holistic development. Schools in Whitefield have all the modern facilities; with academics, they balance everything from extracurricular activities to other factors that make a complete individual. Whitefield is appropriate for families who will give their child an opportunity for not only intellectual but social, emotional, and physical growth, which assures them of a bright future.

Top schools: 

National Public School (NPS): 

National Public School also known as NPS,Whitefield is affiliated to The Central Board of Secondary Education, Govt. of India, New Delhi (CBSE Affiliation No. 830989). It is situated conveniently in the heart of Whitefield in a beautiful, green 4-acre campus. Under highly experienced educators, they strive to empower the students with the knowledge, skills, and values that help him succeed in a constantly changing world.

Address: KG&S and SRB Gurukul, Kumbena Agrahara, Kadugodi Post, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560067

Whitefield Global School:

Whitefield Global School is one of the top CBSE schools in Whitefield, Bangalore. This school is known for academic excellence and holistic education. It is situated in the heart of Whitefield  and it meets the growing educational needs of the area.

Address: KRS Garden, Channasandra Main Rd, near Hope Farm Circle, Ambedkar Nagar, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066

Vydehi School:

Vydehi School of Excellence is a part of the Vydehi Group. This group was established in the year 2009 by Dr. D.K. Audikesavulu Naidu who strongly believed in offering the best education possible for the brilliant and vivid future of students. This school offers excellent teaching staff and an excellent academic performance record.

Address: Vydehi Campus, 82, Whitefield Main Rd, EPIP Zone, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066

Deens Academy:

The Deens Academy is a CBSE school established in May 2006 . They are known for their warm and dedicated team of teaching and support staff who work as one cohesive unit to create a lively learning environment, motivating and fun for every child.

Address: No. 64/1 & 65/2, ECC Rd, Dodsworth Layout, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066

These schools play an important role in the educational world of Whitefield, thus providing a variety of choices to families who want quality education for their children.

Shopping and Entertainment Options

Top Malls: 

Malls in Whitefield are the destination to look for when one wants a break at work or just quality leisure time. These expansive complexes are vibrant hotspots, chock-full of energy and activities, catering to the city's professionals and enthusiasts alike with great food, shopping, entertainment, and recreational experiences on offer-from the thrilling adventure zones to the state-of-the-art cinemas and dynamic events-which will keep everyone occupied. These malls are some of the top places to visit in Whitefield that will keep everyone entertained.

Park Square Mall: 

Park Square Mall sits within the iconic International Tech Park Bangalore (ITPB), one of India's leading IT parks. It offers over 450,000 sq ft of food & beverage, entertainment and fashion options to the vibrant ITPB community and larger catchment of the bustling Whitefield suburb.

Address: ITPB Main Road, International Tech Park, Whitefield Main Rd, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066

Open hours: 11 AM to 10 PM

Nexus Whitefield: 

Nexus Whitefield is a one-stop shop for its neighbourhoods all daily needs of Fashion, Food and Grocery. Part of Nexus Malls Portfolio, Nexus Whitefield Bengaluru is situated with 0.3 million sq.ft. With retail brands, hosts in numerous events, and focused healthy activities within the consumption hub.

Address: 62, Whitefield Main Rd, Prestige Ozone, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066

Open hours: 10 AM - 10 PM

Phoenix Marketcity Mall, Whitefield: 

The Phoenix Marketcity is a mall developed by The Phoenix Mills Co. Ltd in the city of Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. This is the largest mall in Bangalore by area and occupying with total area of 1,000,000 square feet on four floors that house 296 stores, a nine-screen PVR Cinemas multiplex, and a food court.

Address: Whitefield Main Road, Devasandra Industrial Estate, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048

Open hours: 10 AM to 10 PM

These malls in Whitefield provide the residents with a good opportunity to engage in leisure activities, making it easy to unwind after a busy day.

Luxurious Stays in Whitefield

Whitefield has some of the best hotels in the city for house business travelers, tourists, and locals seeking luxurious stays. The excellent hospitality and world-class amenities of these hotels are supported by great contemporary design to make it easy and memorable. Most of the hotels in Whitefield are strategically located close to IT parks, shopping malls, and entertainment hubs so that they may ensure easy stay for professionals and leisure travelers. They have lavishly designed rooms, great gourmet dining options, fitness centers of international standards, and other recreational facilities including swimming pools and spas.

Top Hotels:

Sheraton Grand: 

Sheraton Grand offers Upscale hotels, well-appointed rooms, excellent dining venues, outdoor swimming pool, and a health club. They are known for their luxurious comforts and excellent service.

Address: Prestige Shantiniketan, Hoodi, Thigalarapalya, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048

The Zuri:

The Zuri  is a Chic business hotel located in a busy place but far from the city noise. Provides trendy accommodations and is only 45 minutes from the International Airport.

Location: The Zuri Hotel Building, Hoody Village, 244, Whitefield Main Rd, Maruthi Nagar, KIADB Export Promotion Industrial Area, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048

Lemon Tree Hotel:

Lemon tree hotel is situated in the heart of Whitefield; it takes just 18 minutes to reach Old Airport Road. The place is equipped with all modern amenities and is in close proximity to K.R. Puram station and ITPL.

Location: Plot No. 23, Whitefield Road, EPIP Zone, Brookefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066

Ginger Hotel:

Ginger hotel is a 3-star hotel that offers a fitness center, free private parking, and a restaurant. The place offers free Wi-Fi and room service along with a 24-hour front desk.

Address: SAP LABS, 128, EPIP Phase II, Opp KTPO &, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560037

Vivanta:

This is a 5-star luxury hotel located right at the entrance of International Tech Park Bangalore. It features a contemporary steel-and-glass construction and provides expansive rooms and suites with oversized windows, ergonomic working spaces, Egyptian cotton gowns, flat-screen TV, and tea/coffee making facilities.

Location: Whitefield Main Rd, Pattandur Agrahara, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066

These hotels improve the hospitality landscape in Whitefield by offering a variety of options for business travelers and leisure travelers.

Average Rent for Flats in Whitefield


Whitefield is one of the major residential and commercial hubs in Bangalore where one can find flats for rent. With a wide variety of sizes, amenities, and specific locations, average rental prices for flats vary dramatically in Whitefield. For example, 1 BHK flats range from ₹12,000 to ₹45,000, and 2 BHK flats usually charge more between ₹25,000 and ₹50,000. The rent for the bigger units, 3 BHKs will vary between ₹40,000 and ₹80,000 as a result of proximity to important landmarks and facilities.

On an average, monthly rent for a flat in Whitefield is about ₹45,000 as this area is quite in vogue among IT professionals and families because of excellent infrastructures and amenities available there. Luxury apartments and flats in premium complexes would naturally surpass these averages and could easily offer high-end facilities such as swimming pools, gyms, and security services.

There are a lot of flats for rent in Whitefield, making it quite easy for a person who wants to find some nice flats to live in to get them easily. Connectivity to the major IT parks and commercial centers also drives the rental market, hence adding an appeal to live there.

Conclusion


Summed up, Whitefield is one of the most coveted Bangalore localities, owing to having the best blend of luxury amenities, connectivity, as well as lifestyle. Opportunities for jobbing are numerous in one of the greatest IT parks of the city, while top-class medical facilities ensure fine-tuning treatment within hand reach. Luxurious hospitality, prime educational institutions, thrilling shopping avenues, and excellent community living make Whitefield even more coveted by a few other destinations.
